diagnosis.name: Bean rust
diagnosis.summary: Fungus spread by wind; can make leaves fall early.
diagnosis.why: Small raised reddish brown powdery spots with a yellow ring.

symptoms.text: Reddish brown powdery spots under the leaf
Leaves turn yellow and fall early

today.text: Remove leaves with the most rust spots.

treatment.text: Use a fungicide approved for bean rust when spots first appear.
treatment.safety_note: Follow the label for dose and days before harvest. Wear gloves and a mask.

prevention.text: Plant rust resistant varieties next season.
